name: loops
description: Persistent local loop and workflow runner for deterministic commands and headless AI coding agents. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (loops-serve) + generated SDK. Self-hosted mode runs loops-serve against Hasna-owned Postgres/RDS with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts; the generated storage kit's HASNA_LOOPS_STORAGE_MODE=cloud flag is only its direct-Postgres implementation term.
